import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { activeStorageBlobs } from "./active_storage_blobs";

// Introspected as an owned-child: belongs to active_storage_blobs (its only NOT NULL foreign key) and nothing else references it.
// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "name" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "record_type" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const activeStorageAttachments = defineTable("active_storage_attachments", {
    columns: {
        id: col.bigserial().primaryKey(),
        name: col.text().notNull(),
        recordType: col.text().notNull(),
        recordId: col.bigint().notNull(),
        blobId: col.bigint().notNull(),
        createdAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone").notNull()
    },
    relations: {
        blob: rel.belongsTo(() => activeStorageBlobs, { onDelete: "no action" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
